what: Splits the checker made that the user's timeline does not have, checked by eye on the two-frame strip (missed_cuts.strip_jpeg).
verified_by: Claude Code (the second reviewer), 2026-11-22. All 49 are real hard cuts. Seven of them (Episode 2 1330-1337 s, Episode 6 503.9 s, Episode 7 987.6/989.6 s: alternating close-ups in two long dark cuts and a wide-to-close cut) were first misread as crossfades on downscaled 4-frame thumbnails and confirmed on a ±0.6 s strip at full tile size; the review strip now carries that context row. Several of the 49 are in the opening or ending, whose cuts have analysis switched off (the job skips them).
